description: Migrate QNTA Heatmap from Supabase to PocketBase. Replace Supabase client, auth, and data hooks with PocketBase equivalents. PREREQUISITES: PocketBase binary v0.23+ installed at ./pocketbase/pocketbase, server running on http://127.0.0.1:8090, collections created (imports, properties, outcode_stats), test user created (test@example.com / Password123), and batch API enabled in Dashboard > Settings > Application.

userStories.title: Verify manual setup prerequisites
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify that all manual setup steps are complete before starting the migration coding work.
acceptanceCriteria: PocketBase binary exists at ./pocketbase/pocketbase and version is 0.23.0 or higher (run ./pocketbase/pocketbase --version)
PocketBase server is running and responds at http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/health
.env file exists with VITE_POCKETBASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8090
Test user exists: verify by running curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/collections/users/auth-with-password -d 'identity=test@example.com&password=Password123' returns a valid auth response
imports collection exists: curl http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/collections/imports returns collection metadata
properties collection exists: curl http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/collections/properties returns collection metadata
outcode_stats collection exists: curl http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/collections/outcode_stats returns collection metadata
.gitignore contains pocketbase/pb_data/
Git repo initialized: .git folder exists
userStories.notes: This is a verification-only story. If any check fails, STOP and refer to POCKETBASE_MIGRATION_PLAN.md Part 1 for manual setup instructions.
